user.title: Fantasy Premier League
user.description: Enter your FPL manager ID. You can find it in the URL when you open the Points tab on fantasy.premierleague.com, for example `/entry/1234567/event/1`.

data_description.manager_id: The numeric ID of the FPL team to track. Public data only - no login required.

leagues.title: Mini-leagues
leagues.description: Pick the classic leagues you want a rank sensor for. Your invitational leagues are pre-selected; the rest are the leagues FPL enters everyone into automatically.

data_description.leagues: One sensor per league, showing your rank in it. This costs no extra API calls - the data already arrives with every update. You can change the selection later in the integration options.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Fantasy Premier League API.
error.manager_not_found: No FPL team exists with that manager ID.

abort.already_configured: This manager ID is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: How often to poll the FPL API, in minutes. Scores update roughly every minute during matches, but the API is unofficial - be considerate.
data_description.leagues: Which classic leagues get a rank sensor. Unticking a league removes its sensor and its history.
